text: 有時候我在想，人到底是自己，還是被環境訓練出來的反應？
visual_prompt: Cinematic high-contrast shot, a silhouette of a person standing in a void, glowing blue digital neural networks floating around them like rain, hyper-realistic, 4k, philosophical mood.

text: 我一開始看到行為學派時，它講的是「標的行為」。
visual_prompt: Abstract laboratory aesthetic, a single red glowing dot on a dark petri dish, technical diagrams overlayed, microscope view, minimalist.

text: 行為治療不問：你現在有哪些行為，正在讓你痛苦？比如逃避、焦慮、強迫、解離。
visual_prompt: Close up of a dark vintage typewriter typing words: 'ANXIETY', 'ESCAPE', 'PAIN'. Red ink dripping on the paper, dramatic shadows, moody lighting.

text: 很多人以為那是人格。其實只是以前為了活下來，被強化出來的生存反應。
visual_prompt: A beautiful porcelain mask with a huge crack, through the crack we see glowing mechanical gears and neural synapses, symbolic of survival mechanisms, dark background.

text: 當狗被迫分辨越來越混亂的訊號，最後牠會崩潰。但這真的是病嗎？還是唯一能做出的「正確反應」？
visual_prompt: An old brass bell ringing violently, split screen with chaotic static noise and abstract geometric shapes distorting, high tension, psychological suspense.

text: 既然大腦可以被「塑造」出痛苦，同樣可以被「重塑」。這就是精神可塑性。
visual_prompt: A dark brain silhouette starting to glow with golden light, golden threads weaving and repairing the cracks, beautiful, inspiring, warm lighting.

text: 你不需要挖掘童年。你只需要從現在開始，去設計新的刺激，去強化新的行為。
visual_prompt: Close up of hands holding a glowing futuristic blueprint, the blueprint shows a new neural path, soft cinematic lighting, focus on hope.

text: 你不是環境的犧牲品，你是自己神經迴路的設計師。
visual_prompt: Low angle shot of the silhouette looking at a vast digital horizon, sunrise colors (orange/purple), neural networks blooming like flowers in the sky, powerful ending.
